title: FRESHNESS

fields.evidence.retrievedAt: ISO timestamp set at provider fetch (session-now)
fields.ranking.factors.freshness: 0.6+0.3 if retrievedAt within 24h else lower; observed always 0.9 on B0

observed.note: B0 freshness factor is mostly constant (0.9) when retrievedAt is session-now; not true source modification time

gaps: No source lastmod / revision timestamp from Wikidata/Wikipedia/OpenLibrary
retrievedAt uniqueness 43 across 244 findings — batch-shared timestamps per provider call
Cannot measure real-world staleness of registry facts
implication: Freshness is currently a fetch-recency proxy, not evidence currency. Strategy experiments needing true freshness require provider-native dates or news sources (BS-SRC-02).
